lessons_used: Reordering sign-in was helpful when placed after adoption selection (+5.5%) or photo upload (+3.3%), but placing it after the adoption certificate severely hurt performance (-22.4%).

Specific redesigns and new screens were helpful, including Stage Layout (+7.1%), Story Scroll Redesign (+7.4%), Desktop Visibility Check (+8.0%), Story Stage Layout (+4.1%), and Interactive Welcome Screen (+14.0%), though many other redesigns showed no clear effect or negative impact.

Desktop background notification prompts (+5.1%), path selection helper hints (+3.5%), and sign-in clarifications (+9.9%) were helpful, whereas sound cues, notification toggles/banners, overlay hints, and troubleshooter screens showed no clear effect.
Copy updates, incentives, and waiting screen progress, tip, or estimated time displays consistently showed no clear effect.
Predictions were frequently too high for non-winning changes, predicting gains up to +12.0% on tests that showed no clear effect or caused severe negative drops.
Predictions were too low for several winning tests, predicting negative or modest impact (-8.0% to +2.4%) on changes that ultimately won (+3.3% to +14.0%).

candidates.title: Grid Layout Redesign for Choose Path Screen
candidates.change: Redesign the path selection screen with a clean grid layout presenting companion selection options side by side with visual thumbnails.
candidates.why: The choose_path step has a median duration of 8s but a mean of 514s, indicating that some users stall when choosing their path. A clear grid layout simplifies comparison.

guard.reason: Valid layout redesign of the path selection screen within onboarding.

candidates.score_note: Choose path redesigns have shown positive performance (+3.1%), but requires screen redesign.

candidates.title: Sign-In Mascot Sync Warning Hint
candidates.change: Add an explanatory helper hint below sign-in options clarifying that signing into an existing account restores saved pets, preventing accidental duplicate account creation.
candidates.why: Support receives frequent complaints about pets missing or reset after signing in again (8 emails), showing confusion around account linking.

sign_in.hint: Signing into your existing account will restore your saved desktop pets and customizations.

guard.reason: Valid helper text added to the sign-in screen.

candidates.score_note: Sign-in hints have strong empirical success (+9.9%) and direct support email backing.

candidates.title: Pet Preview Confirmation Screen Before Certificate
candidates.change: Add a pet preview confirmation screen immediately before adoption certificate creation so users can review their rendered pet visual.
candidates.why: Adoption has the highest drop-off in the funnel (64.1% conversion) and support reports custom pet generation failures or unexpected visual results.

new_pet_preview.headline: Meet Your Companion
new_pet_preview.body: Here is a preview of your pet companion before signing the official adoption certificate.

guard.reason: Valid preview screen inserted into onboarding flow without removing required steps.

candidates.score_note: Targets highest funnel drop-off (64.1% adoption rate) and frequent user reports, but requires new screen.

candidates.title: Card Layout Redesign for Adoption Certificate Screen
candidates.change: Redesign the adoption certificate screen using a framed card layout to elevate the feeling of an official certificate.
candidates.why: Adoption conversion drops to 64.1% with long mean times (1017s). Restructuring certificate layout improves visual clarity and completion rates.

guard.reason: Valid card layout redesign of the adoption certificate screen.

candidates.score_note: Adoption step has high drop-off, but prior adoption redesigns consistently degraded performance (-3.0%).

candidates.title: Carousel Layout Redesign for Waiting Screen
candidates.change: Redesign the generation waiting screen into a carousel layout to showcase pet animations while assets load in the background.
candidates.why: The home stage (waiting step) has high mean wait time (2336s) and 82.9% conversion; a dynamic carousel visual structure keeps users engaged during generation.

guard.reason: Valid carousel layout redesign of the waiting screen.

candidates.score_note: Home redesigns historically performed poorly (-8.6%) and waiting screen displays showed no clear effect.

candidates.title: Split Layout Redesign for Home Intro Screen
candidates.change: Change the home intro screen layout to a split view displaying desktop companion preview on one side and launch actions on the other.
candidates.why: The final onboarding step drops to 76.4% completion with a mean time of 5815s. A split layout clearly separates desktop preview from action triggers.

guard.reason: Valid split layout redesign of the home intro screen.

candidates.score_note: Finish step loses 23.6% of users, but layout changes have mixed results.

candidates.title: Upload Photos Clarity Body Text Update
candidates.change: Update the body text on the photo upload screen with clear lighting and file format recommendations.
candidates.why: Support received reports of custom pet creation failing or looking wrong (3 emails), which often stems from poor photo input quality.

upload_photos.body: Upload 1 to 3 well-lit photos facing forward for the most accurate custom pet generation.

guard.reason: Valid copy update on the photo upload screen.

candidates.score_note: Cheap text update with support evidence, but copy changes consistently show no clear effect.

candidates.title: Companion Interaction Modes Screen Before Finish
candidates.change: Insert a new screen before home intro introducing pet behavior modes on the desktop.
candidates.why: Users contact support post-onboarding expressing confusion on how to control, hide, or talk to their desktop pet (3 emails).

new_interaction_modes.headline: Desktop Companion Behaviors
new_interaction_modes.body: Your pet can roam freely on top of windows, sit on your taskbar, or respond when clicked.

guard.reason: Valid new screen added before home intro inside onboarding.

candidates.score_note: New screens at finish step have proven track record (+5.3%) and address support confusion.

candidates.title: Story Screen Headline Clarification
candidates.change: Update the headline on the story screen to clearly explain that users will create or adopt a desktop companion.
candidates.why: The initial choose_path step exhibits extreme mean completion time (514s vs 8s median), signaling initial ambiguity for a subset of users.

story.headline: Welcome to Your Virtual Desktop Companion

guard.reason: Valid headline update on the story screen.

candidates.score_note: Simple config copy update, but copy updates historically show negligible impact (+0.4%).

candidates.title: Card Layout Redesign for Sign-In Screen
candidates.change: Redesign the sign-in screen to a card layout focusing attention cleanly on authentication options.
candidates.why: Sign-in screen stalling or non-appearance accounts for user support tickets (2 emails). A focused card layout prevents rendering bugs on high-res displays.

guard.reason: Valid card layout redesign of the sign-in screen.

candidates.score_note: Addresses display bug reported in emails, but sign-in redesigns carry risk.

Specific redesigns (Stage Layouts, Scroll Redesign, Choose Path Grid), new screens (Desktop Visibility Check, Interactive Welcome Screen), hints (Path Selection Hint, Sign-In Clarification), and background notification prompts (+5.1%) were helpful.
Copy updates, incentives, sound cues, notification toggles or banners, waiting screen info displays, and several other redesigns or new screens showed no clear effect.
Predictions were frequently too high for non-winning changes, predicting gains up to +12.0% on tests that showed no clear effect or caused severe drops.
Predictions were too low for several winning tests, predicting negative or modest impact (-8.0% to +2.4%) on changes that ultimately won (+3.3% to +14.0%).
